comparison_method.basis: Pure observable-level application of the existing REFERENCE_PERIODIC_CONVERGENCE_V2 metric equations/thresholds to cycle 104 vs cycle 15. The standard comparator was not called and no identities or hashes were rewritten, because the two full configuration hashes correctly differ in initial-state fields.
comparison_method.configuration_differences: Target conditions match; configuration differences are only expected initialized state fields (initial chamber state/species, duct initial state/species). See pilot contract and source-bound files.
